context_page.note: Not Book IV text. Page 284 is part of an alphabetical subject index (register): red section letters 'J.' and 'K.', one entry per line with a page reference in a right-hand column. No grids, no 'Lib: IV. Cap:' heading, no item numbering, so there is no running chapter to trace. Certain: Book IV's text has already ended before physical page 284; where exactly it ends is outside this batch and was not examined.
